name: moc-record
title: Management of change record
for_each: select id, code from changes where status not in ('cancelled') order by code

sections.title: The change
sections.sql: select c.code, c.title, s.name as site, c.change_type, c.classification, c.risk_level, c.status, c.requested_by, c.owner, c.raised_on, c.expires_on, c.description from changes c join sites s on s.id = c.site_id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Before the change: what was considered
sections.sql: select technical_basis, safety_impact, affects_procedures, affects_drawings, affects_safety_case, regulator_notified_on, regulator_reference from changes where id = $1

sections.title: Risk reviews
sections.sql: select method, held_on, leader, attendees, risk_before, risk_after, findings from risk_reviews where change_id = $1 order by held_on

sections.title: Sign-offs
sections.sql: select role, person, decision, decided_on, note from approvals where change_id = $1 order by role

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select code, phase, kind, description, owner, due, done_on, evidence from actions where change_id = $1 order by phase, due

name: pssr-certificate
title: Pre-start-up safety review
for_each: select id, code from changes where pssr_on is not null order by code

sections.title: Change
sections.sql: select c.code, c.title, s.name as site, c.classification, c.risk_level, c.expires_on from changes c join sites s on s.id = c.site_id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Confirmed before start-up
sections.note: Each pre-start-up action with the evidence recorded against it: construction to design, procedures in place, people trained.
sections.sql: select code, kind, description, owner, done_on, evidence from actions where change_id = $1 and phase = 'pre_startup' order by code

sections.title: Sign-offs held at the review
sections.sql: select role, person, decision, decided_on from approvals where change_id = $1 order by role

sections.title: Review
sections.sql: select pssr_by as reviewed_by, pssr_on as reviewed_on, pssr_note as note, started_up_on from changes where id = $1
